label: Bible Study
prompt: The _____ is the LORD'S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
verse: The earth is the LORD'S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
note: David's reminder of who holds the deed — Paul quotes it in 1 Corinthians 10 over a question about meat.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: As far as the east is from the _____, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
verse: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
note: East and west never meet — that's exactly how far God moves our sins away. North and south would've had an end.

label: Sunday School
prompt: But God prepared a _____ when the morning rose the next day, and it smote the gourd that it withered.
verse: But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day, and it smote the gourd that it withered.
note: God prepared a gourd for Jonah's shade, then a worm to wither it — an object lesson about caring for the wrong things.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for _____.
verse: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.
note: Paul builds Romans 4 and Galatians 3 on this line — Abraham's faith was credited long before circumcision or the law.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Not forsaking the _____ of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
verse: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
note: Not forsaking 'the assembling of ourselves together' — the verse every pastor quotes about Sunday attendance.
